explanation: OEIS A185895 (e.g.f. Π_{k≥1}(1 − x^k/k!)), P. Bala conjecture 1: 'a(n) differs in sign from a(n−1) iff n is a triangular number.' The formal a(n) = n!·[x^n] Π_{k≤n}(1 − x^k/k!) (factors with k > n do not affect the coefficient; floor of an integer), and the statement a(n)·a(n−1) < 0 ⇔ n = k(k+1)/2, for n > 0. Faithful.
